verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any control over whether user data is used to train AI models. The pack does show related data-control features: local-by-default storage, self-hosting with "complete control over your data," and an Ollama integration. These are adjacent privacy controls, not the training-prevention capability the story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
